places.src: Time Out Singapore; Star Wine List 2026
places.vibe: Bauhaus wine room upstairs, lounge with DJs Wed-Sat below
places.d: A wine room and cocktail lounge in the Mondrian with live R&B and jazz sessions plus DJs Wednesday to Saturday. Two Star Wine List awards in its first year.
places.tip: Go Friday after 10pm for the DJ; start upstairs with a glass, finish in the lounge.

places.vibe: Loud New York import, fortune-teller at the door, packed and flirty
places.london: Chiltern Firehouse bar: busy, glam, see-and-be-seen
places.d: The NYC bar brand's Singapore outpost: free-poured drinks, a dining room behind and a crowd that stays late. More party than reverence.
places.tip: Late on a Friday; eat in the back room if you want a table.

places.addr: Hotel Tower 2 lobby, Marina Bay Sands, 10 Bayfront Ave
places.src: Star Wine List; The Hotel Journal (Apr 2026)
places.vibe: Dark glam lobby room, banquettes, a dressed-up crowd
places.d: Tetsuya Wakuda's sleek Japanese room in the MBS lobby, the nearest thing Singapore has to Nobu. Hotel-crowd glossy, but done properly.
places.tip: Book a banquette and order sashimi and the wagyu.

places.addr: Galleria Level, The Shoppes at Marina Bay Sands, 2 Bayfront Ave
places.vibe: Moody Hong Kong-glam dining room, big groups and dates
places.london: Nobu: glam, expensive, a scene room
places.d: Hong Kong's glam Cantonese brand in a dark, designed room at MBS. The applewood Peking duck is the reason. It's in a mall and it's a chain, so it's slick more than cool.
places.tip: Pre-order the Peking duck and come in a group of four or more.

places.vibe: Dark, sexy steakhouse with tabletop grills and a dressed-up crowd
places.london: Chiltern Firehouse: glam, buzzy, a night out
places.d: The Michelin-starred New York Korean steakhouse, now at COMO Orchard: grills in the tables, a loud room and a well-dressed crowd. The latest review is from 2025, so confirm it's still open before you book.
places.tip: Order the Butcher's Feast for the table and start at the bar.

places.vibe: Small shophouse, chef-run, a grown-up Club St crowd
places.london: Acre: cool neighbourhood small plates, mid-price
places.d: Drew Nocente's Australian-Italian small plates and fresh pasta, with the menu refreshed in 2026 and now open seven days. Time Out says it is more confident than ever.
places.tip: Get the wagyu tartare cannoli and the crab-and-uni tarts, then a pasta each.

places.vibe: 70s grandma-chic: chandeliers, old TVs, a cool Keong Saik crowd
places.london: Toklas meets Chiltern: design-led and buzzy
places.d: A playful 'almost Chinese' bistro from the Marcy's team, in a mad retro room. It is one of the cooler new rooms on Keong Saik.
places.tip: Golden Prawn Croque Madame and cod milt; book a Friday.

places.src: Time Out Singapore; F Zine; Seth Lui
places.vibe: Edgy, sexy seafood bistro-bar, loud music, glamorous Duxton crowd
places.london: Chiltern Firehouse: glam, buzzy, the scene
places.d: A seafood sharing-plates bar with a dark, mirrored room and a party feel late on. Reviewers rave about the sauces. Its company filings are current to April 2026, but the newest reviews date from 2024.
places.tip: Start with crab toast at the bar, then book a late table for the arroz negro.

places.vibe: Art-deco colonial fantasy rooms, birthdays and dates
places.d: Indian food in a theatrical set of designed rooms. It's fun, it's buzzy, and it's a bit of a stage set. The tandoori lamb saddle is the order. Only an undated listing confirms it is open, so check before you go.
places.tip: Chai masala cocktail first, then the tandoori lamb saddle to share.

places.d: A tiny cocktail bar built around the Edward Hopper painting, with small American plates. Intimate rather than loud.
places.tip: Go as two, early, before the Tanjong Pagar crawl fills it.

places.vibe: Polished, playful upstairs bar, raw-bar snacks, dressed-up after-work crowd
places.d: The Jigger & Pony group's upstairs bar, ten years old in 2026 with a 'Timeless' menu and tableside blazer serves. It's a good first stop before Live Twice downstairs.
places.tip: Order the house Gibson with the quail egg, then go downstairs to Live Twice.

places.vibe: Upstairs townhouse bar with a garden, creative and green-minded
places.d: A sustainability-minded cocktail bar with inventive small plates in a second-floor townhouse. Quieter and more designed than its Amoy St neighbours.
places.tip: Eat here as well: the small plates work as dinner.

places.vibe: Airy all-day brunch café, expat and Robertson Quay crowd
places.d: The 2013 flagship that started Robertson Quay's café scene. It's a proper brunch room, busy at weekends. It is a chain now, and the most recent review is from 2023, so check it before you go.
places.tip: Weekday morning, before the weekend queue.
